# Sensible

> Sensible is a developer-first platform for extracting structured data from documents, including PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and images. Use Sensible to build document-automation features into your vertical SaaS products.

This file contains links to the Sensible documentation to help LLMs understand the platform.

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL

## welcome

- [Overview](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/overview.md): Sensible: developer-first PDF data extraction and intelligent document processing. Get JSON from PDFs, Office documents, emails, spreadsheets, and images.
- [Getting started](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/getting-started-ai.md): Extract data from PDFs with an LLM in minutes. Write natural-language prompts for AI data extraction, then publish and test them as a Sensible config.
- [Integrating](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/integrate.md): Export extracted data or send it to any application with Sensible's SDKs, API, email forwarding, Zapier, MCP server, or quick extraction.
- [Quality control](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/quality-control.md): Learn about quality control options for extracted document data, including custom validation, real-time monitoring dashboards, and human review workflows.
- [Choosing an extraction approach](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/author.md): Learn when to use LLM-based or layout-based document extraction methods in Sensible, and how to choose the right approach for your document complexity.

## integrations

- [SDK guides](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sdk-guides.md): Explore Sensible SDK guides and quickstarts for Node/TypeScript and Python to extract document data
- [Python SDK quickstart](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/python-sdk-quickstart.md): Learn how to install and use the Sensible Python SDK to extract structured data from documents and classify document types with quickstart examples.
- [Node SDK quickstart](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/node-sdk-quickstart.md): Learn how to install, initialize, and use the Sensible Node SDK to extract structured data from documents and classify them by type.
- [Zapier overview](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/zapier.md): Learn how Sensible's Zapier integration extracts data from PDFs and documents and sends it to emails, databases, Google Sheets, and other destinations.
- [Integrate with Airtable using Zapier](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/zapier-getting-started.md): Learn how to send Sensible document extraction data into an Airtable database using Zapier, with step-by-step setup for triggers, actions, and field mapping.
- [Integrate with Slack and Google Sheets using Zapier](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/zapier-tutorial-2.md): Learn how to set up a two-Zap Zapier workflow that extracts data from Slack file uploads using Sensible and saves results as spreadsheets in Google Drive.
- [API quickstart](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/quickstart.md): Make your first Sensible API call: run one curl command on an example document and get a hello world JSON response with extracted data.
- [Quick extraction](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/quick-extraction.md): Upload documents in bulk to Sensible, run extractions using document types you create in your account, and download the extracted data as spreadsheets or JSON.
- [SenseML to spreadsheet reference](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/excel-reference.md): Learn how Sensible converts extracted PDF data into Excel or CSV files, including rules for tables, fields, and multi-document spreadsheet combining.

## document extraction

- [Getting started with layout-based extractions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/getting-started.md): Write deterministic, template-based extraction rules in SenseML to extract data from forms by layout, using anchors and methods.
- [Out-of-the-box extractions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/library-quickstart.md): Import pre-built templates from Sensible's configuration library to extract data from bank statements, tax forms, pay stubs, and more in minutes.
- [Multi-document extractions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/portfolio.md): Split a PDF containing multiple documents, such as a loan package, and extract each document's data separately using LLM or fingerprint segmentation.
- [Repeating layouts](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/repeat-layouts.md): Learn how to extract complex repeating data from documents using layout-based sections to split content into subdocuments for structured field extraction.
- [Best practices](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/best-practices.md): Best practices for building, optimizing, and managing your applications effectively with guidance on recommended approaches and standards.
- [Extracting handwriting and OCR text](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/handwriting.md): Tips and tricks for extracting handwriting and OCR text from scanned documents, including engine selection, region definition, and confidence scoring.
- [Fallback LLM configs](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/fallback-configs.md): Use fallback LLM configs to handle long-tail document variations and capture data from smaller, less common document providers within a document type.
- [Go-live checklist](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/go-live.md): Essential pre-production checklist for deploying Sensible document extraction configs, covering publishing, naming consistency, and null handling.
- [Handling document variations](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/document-variations.md): Handle document variations in SenseML by conditionally executing extraction fields across different layouts, formats, and content structures for unified output.
- [Optimizing extraction performance](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/performance.md): Optimize Sensible extraction performance by improving document and document type settings, reducing OCR load, and choosing faster extraction methods.
- [Qualifying LLM accuracy](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/confidence.md): Qualify extraction accuracy with LLM confidence signals like 'ambiguous query', which are more nuanced than numeric confidence scores.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/troubleshoot.md): Learn how to troubleshoot Sensible configs and extractions using API logging, text inspection, SenseML linting, and visual query tracing tools.

## monitor and qa

- [Monitoring extraction metrics](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/metrics.md): Learn how to monitor real-time extraction metrics in the Sensible dashboard, including coverage, document counts, and most-used configurations.
- [Validating extractions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/validate-extractions.md): Write JsonLogic validation rules to check extracted data, including field-level validation of values and sums, and flag extractions for human review.
- [Human review](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/human-review.md): Use the Human Review tab for human-in-the-loop (HITL) manual review: correct flagged extractions, check failed validations, and approve or reject.
- [Human review implementation](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/human-review-implementation.md): Learn how to integrate human-in-the-loop review into your document extraction workflow using webhooks, review triggers, and Sensible's review interface.

## document type classification

- [Classifying documents by type](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/classify.md): Classify documents by type with Sensible's document classification API, or as you extract portfolios and emails.

## api

- [API tutorial](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-tutorial.md): Document extraction API tutorials: step-by-step guides to extracting structured data with the Sensible API via sync, async, and webhook extraction.
- [Try synchronous extraction](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-tutorial-sync.md): Learn how to use Sensible's synchronous /extract endpoint to extract data from documents via Postman or cURL, using a 1040 tax form as an example.
- [Try asynchronous extraction from your URL](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-tutorial-async-1.md): Learn how to use Sensible's asynchronous extract_from_url endpoint to extract document data from publicly accessible or pre-signed URLs using Postman or cURL.
- [Try asynchronous extraction from a Sensible URL](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-tutorial-async-2.md): Learn how to use Sensible's asynchronous API with Sensible-provided URLs to extract document data, ideal when public or pre-signed URLs aren't available.
- [Try a webhook](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-tutorial-webhook.md): Set a webhook URL on a Sensible extraction request and get the webhook payload pushed when extraction status changes, instead of polling.
- [Code examples](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/examples.md): Ready-to-use starter code examples for calling the Sensible API, available in the official sensible-code-examples GitHub repository.
- [API reference](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/api-reference.md): Learn how to integrate Sensible into your application with the complete API reference documentation.

## senseml reference

- [SenseML reference introduction](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/senseml-reference-introduction.md): SenseML is Sensible's document query language. Use this reference to configure fields, methods, preprocessors, sections, and settings.
- [Field query object](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/field-query-object.md): Define an extraction field, the basic SenseML query unit. A field uses a layout- or LLM-based method and returns its data as JSON output.
- [Anchor object](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/anchor.md): Find data at variable positions by searching for a nearby keyword or landmark. Covers simple and complex syntax and search range parameters.
- [Match object](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/match.md): Define text matching criteria for anchors and more: string, regex, fuzzy, boolean, first, and repeat matches.
- [Method object](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/method.md): Choose LLM-based or layout-based methods, and use global parameters like tiebreaker and lineFilters to extract target data.
- [Types](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/types.md): Normalize data: filter and format extracted values by data type, such as date, currency, and address, with custom date formats.
- [Layout-based methods](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/layout-based-methods.md): Positional, deterministic extraction methods in SenseML, such as Box, Table, Checkbox, Row, and Region, that extract data from documents by layout.
- [Box](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/box.md): Extract text from bordered boxes in documents, with parameters for position, offset, overlap, and border detection settings.
- [Checkbox](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/checkbox.md): Extract boolean selection status from PDF checkboxes using form metadata or pixel recognition, with parameters for position and size.
- [Column](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/column.md): Extract lines above or below an anchor line based on x extent alignment or 50% overlap, with parameters and examples.
- [Document range](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/document-range.md): Extract consecutive lines between upper and lower bounds.
- [Fixed table](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/fixed-table.md): Extracts fixed-column tables from documents by anchoring on table titles or column headings, returning collated column data for consistent table layouts.
- [Intersection](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/intersection.md): Table cell lookup: extract the value at the cross-point of a row and column, ideal for tables with empty cells or variable text positions.
- [Label](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/label.md): Extract labeled values. Note this method is brittle, so use alternative methods where possible
- [Nearest checkbox](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/nearest-checkbox.md): Extract checkbox selection status from documents using OCR and PDF form metadata, with flexible configuration options.
- [Paragraph](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/paragraph.md): Extract paragraphs from documents, including multi-column layouts and page-spanning content, with configuration examples and output.
- [Passthrough](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/passthrough.md): Return an anchor's regex match directly as output, for pattern matching without further extraction steps.
- [Regex](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/regex.md): Extract lines matching a regular expression, including parameters, capturing groups, flags, and usage examples.
- [Region](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/region.md): Extract text from a fixed position: a rectangle set in inches from an anchor, for coordinate-based extraction. Or capture the region as an image.
- [Row](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/row.md): Extract text next to a label, such as the value in a key-value pair, or every line to the left or right of an anchor on the same row.
- [Signature](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/signature.md): Detect signatures in a document region by checking if more than 3% of pixels are dark, using configurable position, offset, and size parameters.
- [Text Table](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/text-table.md): Extract table data from PDFs using column coordinates in inches, with faster performance than other table methods and support for unusually formatted tables.
- [LLM-based methods](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/llm-based-methods.md): Compare Sensible's AI extraction methods for extracting lists, tables, and key-value pairs from unstructured documents like contracts and leases.
- [List](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/list.md): Extract lists from PDFs with an LLM, such as invoice line items, resume work history, or vehicles on an insurance policy.
- [NLP table](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/nlp-table.md): Prompt-based LLM table extraction: describe each column in plain language to extract tables, including tables that span multiple pages.
- [Query group](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/query-group.md): Use LLM extraction to pull facts and key-value pairs, such as an invoice date or policy limit, from documents and images. Includes prompt tips.
- [Preprocessors](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/preprocessors.md): Clean up documents before extraction with preprocessing options: image pre-processing (deskew, rotate, scale), selective OCR, and header removal.
- [Deskew](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/deskew.md): For corner cases, correct skewed document alignment in Sensible.
- [Ligature](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ligature.md): Intelligently replace Unicode ligatures in PDF text extraction using configurable mappings and dictionary lookups.
- [Linearize](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/linearize.md): Break multi-column or block-layout document pages into coordinate-based blocks.
- [Merge lines](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/merge-lines.md): Fix broken text lines from poor quality scans and handwriting OCR by merging oversplit, overlapping, or misaligned lines.
- [Multicolumn](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/multicolumn.md): Ensure Sensible correctly sorts text lines into columns instead of across the full page width.
- [NLP](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/nlp.md): Configuration reference for setting full prompt parameters across all LLM-based methods.
- [OCR preprocessor](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ocr-preprocessor.md): Force OCR on specific pages, such as scanned or handwritten pages in a PDF with embedded text. Select pages by text match or line count.
- [Page range](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/page-range.md): Limit document extraction to specific pages using startPage and endPage parameters.
- [Remove footer](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/remove-footer.md): Strip repeating bottom-of-page elements automatically or via configurable text matching.
- [Remove header](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/remove-header.md): Remove repeating headers from PDF pages in Sensible using automatic detection or configurable text matching.
- [Remove lines](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/remove-lines.md): Delete matching text lines, including watermarks and page numbers, from all pages before extraction.
- [Remove page](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/remove-page.md): Delete PDF pages matching specified text, with parameters and examples for targeted page removal.
- [Rotate page](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/rotate-page.md): For edge cases, correct page orientation by aligning matched anchor text horizontally in your document extractions.
- [Scale](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/scale.md): Correct text size variations in scanned documents like ID cards and receipts.
- [Split lines](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/split-lines.md): Split horizontally distributed lines in typewriter-style documents using whitespace or custom separator characters.
- [Computed field methods](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/computed-field-methods.md): How Computed Field methods transform extracted document data using built-in logic, LLMs, external context, or custom logic to clean and standardize.
- [Concatenate](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/concatenate.md): Join outputs of two or more fields into a single string or array.
- [Constant](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/constant.md): Add fixed key/value pairs to document extractions, such as form names or policy durations not present in the document.
- [Mapper](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/mapper.md): Standardize extracted field output using a case-sensitive lookup table for consistent data formatting across document configs.
- [Pick values](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/pick-values.md): Extract specific values from field groups, such as selected checkboxes or specific dropdown answers.
- [Split](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/split.md): Extract specific substrings from a field's string output by splitting on a delimiter.
- [Suppress output](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/suppress-output.md): Keep extraction results clean by excluding specified intermediate fields from extraction output.
- [Zip](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/zip.md): Combine tables, arrays, and sections into rows using source field IDs, with regex support.
- [Sections](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections.md): Extract nested or repeating data and nested tables, such as claims in a loss run, into an array of objects by defining repeating sections.
- [Claims loss run example](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-loss-run.md): Example showing how to extract repeated claims data from grouped document sections using section ranges, stop parameters, and match-all fields.
- [Labeled rows example](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-labeled-rows.md): Use vertical section groups to extract data from complex tables that have column labels and row labels.
- [Advanced: nested columns example](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-nested-columns.md): Learn how to extract repeating vertical column groups from documents using nested sections in SenseML, with a step-by-step config example and JSON output.
- [Advanced: nested table example](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-nested-table.md): Learn how to extract nested tables using vertical section groups with column selection and relative column coordinates in Sensible's JSON config.
- [Advanced: Table grid example](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-table-grid.md): Extract table grid data using nested vertical sections in SenseML, including handling repeated anchors and outputting structured car model and trim data.
- [Advanced: Zip sections](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-zip.md): Zip multiple table sections together in SenseML using section groups, column selection, and field extraction order to combine data from separate tables.
- [Advanced: Zip and flatten nested sections](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-copy-from-sections.md): Learn how to use Copy from Sections and zip methods to flatten nested section groups into clean, simplified output when extracting structured document data.
- [Advanced: Transform sections data](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-copy-to-section.md): Learn how to transform sections data using computed fields to copy and concatenate parent fields across sections and redact sensitive data like phone numbers.
- [Advanced: External anchors for sections](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/sections-example-external-range.md): Learn how to use static and dynamic external anchors in Sensible to extract fields from sections that lack internal labeling text, with JSON config examples.
- [Spreadsheet extraction](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/cell-rows.md): Extract data from large spreadsheets with thousands of rows by specifying column headers and row ranges.
- [Config settings](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/config-settings.md): Learn how config templates define data extraction rules for similar documents, with settings for fingerprints and verbosity within document types.
- [Fingerprint](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/fingerprint.md): Handle multiple document layouts by matching text: choose a config per form revision or vendor, or find each document's pages in a portfolio.
- [Verbosity](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/verbosity.md): Configure output levels for document extraction that add source text lines, position data, and bounding polygon metadata.
- [Document type settings](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/document-type-settings.md): Learn how to configure document type settings in Sensible, including extraction templates, OCR engine, fingerprint mode, validations, and human review options.
- [Document type descriptions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/descriptions.md): Improve LLM-based page range segmentation and document classification in your Sensible account.
- [Fingerprint mode](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/fingerprint-mode.md): Control extraction strictness for standalone files.
- [OCR engine](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ocr-engine.md): Options for extracting text from images, including Amazon, Microsoft, Lazarus, and Google engines with their use cases and limitations.
- [OCR level](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ocr-level.md): Control how and when OCR is applied to PDF documents, from skipping OCR entirely to page-by-page detection.
- [Advanced computed field methods](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/advanced-computed-field-methods.md): Advanced methods for computed fields including conditional execution, custom computation, copying data between sections, and retrieving file metadata.
- [Add computed fields](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/add-computed-fields.md): Transform extracted tables by adding, removing, or concatenating columns using computed field arrays.
- [Conditional execution](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/conditional.md): Handle document variations and extract different fields based on pass/fail conditions.
- [Copy from sections](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/copy-from-sections.md): Extract and flatten field values from a source section group.
- [Copy to section](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/copy-to-section.md): Duplicate field output into each section of a section group, including parameters and configuration examples.
- [Custom computation](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/custom-computation.md): Define calculated fields with JsonLogic for post-processing, such as summing fields, mapping arrays, or checking for nulls.
- [Custom computation group](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/custom-computation-group.md): Transform extracted document data with JsonLogic and return multiple calculated fields.
- [Extra data](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/extra-data.md): Inject request-time data into extraction configs to validate, transform, and cross-check extracted fields across documents.
- [Get file metadata](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/get-file-metadata.md): Retrieve document file metadata such as filename, MIME content type, and page count.
- [Postprocessors](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/postprocessors.md): Transform extracted data into a custom output schema. Supports multiple data serialization formats.
- [JSON postprocessor](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/json-postprocessor.md): Transform extracted data into a custom JSON output schema
- [XML postprocessor](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/xml-postprocessor.md): Transform extracted data into a custom XML output schema
- [Concepts](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/concepts.md): Learn advanced concepts and in-depth topics to deepen your understanding of the subject matter covered in this documentation.
- [Accuracy measures](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/accuracy-measures.md): Learn how to measure extraction accuracy in Sensible using logical validations, OCR confidence scores, LLM confidence signals, and extraction coverage metrics.
- [Advanced LLM prompt configuration](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/prompt.md): Configure advanced LLM prompt context in Sensible using embeddings, summarization, prompt chaining, or multimodal engines to improve extraction accuracy.
- [Anchor variables](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/anchor-nuances.md): Define and reuse anchor variables in Sensible for concise syntax, including examples with named anchors and conditional extraction across multiple fields.
- [DevOps platform](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/devops-platform.md): Sensible DevOps platform overview covering document ingestion, classification, and extraction workflow with OCR, SenseML queries, and structured data output.
- [Environments](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/environments.md): Test configuration updates in a Sensible Development environment before publishing to production, including tips for accurate classification testing.
- [Extraction coverage](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/coverage.md): How Sensible calculates extraction coverage scores, set human review thresholds by document type, and interpret coverage results.
- [Fallback fields](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/fallbacks.md): Learn how to use fallback fields in Sensible to handle document variations by specifying backup extraction methods when a field fails to return data.
- [Field extraction order](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/field-order.md): How Sensible's field extraction order works, including default sequencing of fields, computed fields, and sections.
- [Image processing](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/images.md): Learn how to extract, query, and locate non-text images in documents using LLM-based, region-based, or range-based methods in Sensible.
- [Intelligent document processing](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/idp.md): Intelligent document processing (IDP) automates data extraction. Use probabilistic or deterministic techniques depending on document variability.
- [JsonLogic extensions](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/jsonlogic.md): Transform extracted data and validate it with JsonLogic, a JSON rules engine, using Sensible's custom operators. Includes syntax tips and examples.
- [Ligatures](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ligatures.md): Learn what ligatures are in PDF text extraction, how they cause garbled Unicode output, and how to detect and fix them using the ligature preprocessor.
- [Lines](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/lines.md): Learn how Sensible defines, sorts, and groups lines of text in documents, including boundary boxes, y-axis sorting, and line grouping behavior.
- [LLM features overview](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/llm-features.md): LLM-powered features for document data extraction and classification, including tables, lists, multimodal data, and portfolio segmentation.
- [LLM models](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/llm-models.md): LLM models available in Sensible for document extraction methods, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google options across List, Query Group, and NLP Table.
- [Match arrays](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/match-arrays.md): Learn how Sensible match arrays work, including reverse match arrays and how they differ from anchor start parameters for locating target lines in documents.
- [OCR](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/ocr.md): Sensible OCRs scanned PDFs and images automatically. Configure OCR level, per-page OCR, and the engine: Amazon, Google, or Microsoft.
- [Section nuances](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/section-nuances.md): How Sensible handles sections and vertical sections, including range detection, column recognition, and column selection configuration.
- [Supported file types](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/file-types.md): Extract data from PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, JPEG, PNG, and TIFF files. Support for each file format varies by operation.
- [Table methods](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/table-methods.md): Extract PDF tables with the NLP Table, Fixed Table, or Text Table method. Compare methods' speed, multi-page support, merged cells, and checkboxes.
- [Visual troubleshooting in the SenseML editor](https://docs.sensible.so/docs/color.md): Learn how to trace extracted fields to their source text with color-coded overlays, and how to test and troubleshoot configs with the SenseML editor's options

## api reference

The Sensible API is described by the following OpenAPI specifications:

- [Classification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_classification.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_configuration.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Email processors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_email.json): OpenAPI specification
- [Extraction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sensible-hq/sensible-docs/refs/heads/v0/reference/openapi_extraction.json): OpenAPI specification
